results.title: The Republican Party Is Losing Its Edge With Voters on the Economy

results.content: An average of national polls has 38.6 percent of Americans giving Trump a thumbs up today, a 0.4-point increase from where he stood on August 3. In comparison, 57.7 percent give him a thumbs down, a drop of 1.1 points from last month’s number. Trump’s net approval rating now stands at -19.1 points. His lowest number so far this year was the -20.6 points he recorded last month. [...] Higher gas prices may be among the economic headwinds taking their toll on Republican voters. The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment survey found that Republicans’ consumer sentiment fell 9.5 points from July to August.
